statements.label: Theorem 1
statements.restatement: In the chamber j>1, b>j, 0<ab<1, p>0, p(j-1)<1, 0<c<1/j-a (d=1), no spectrally realizable source has 1<b<=b* or 0<c<=k (b*=(1+r+sqrt(1-r^2))/2, k=b(1-r)^2/(b-r)^2, r=sqrt(ab)), for any q,e>=0. Mechanism: G>0 there, contradicting G=0.

statements.label: Lemma 1
statements.restatement: In the chamber, with F(u)=A0u^2+B0u+K, any root of G with q,e>=0 has F(u)<=0 and A0<0; if moreover c>k and e<1/(c-k) (old core failure), no root exists when A0+B0(b+1)(c-k)+K(b+1)^2(c-k)^2>=0.
